newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes barely moved vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes barely moved vs dollar.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed barely moved against the dollar in dull Tuesday trade which saw virtually no commercial demand, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.34 to the greenback after opening at about the same level, which was the Central Bank's buying level. On Monday it closed at 58.35.
"It was a very lethargic market today," said an American Express Bank dealer. "The market was well offerd, but the problem was there wern't any bids."
"There was absolutely no demand today," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
Overseas weakness of the dollar and the Central Bank's action contributed to keeping speculators out too, dealers said.
The Central Bank pushed down the dollar by one local cent, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.3283 and 59.5067.
Overnight call money closed at its opening level of 13 percent after rising to 14.5 percent during the day, dealers said.
